summary: Find the Dragon Tools of legend to stand up to the Evil Dragon in a fantasy RPG!
description:
*Notice*
In the case in-game letters are hard to read, try changing "Quality Settings" in the game Settings to "Normal".
Thank you for your cooperation.

Liege Dragon is a fantasy RPG with an adventure to find the Dragon Tools of the Three Heroes, to stand up to the revived Evil Dragon!

The Revived Evil Dragon...
A princess whose father has been killed, and who now must lead the kingdom...
A young man who has collapsed on a mountain, his memory completely lost...
In order to stand up to the menace of the Evil Dragon, the young man and the princess set off on an adventure, in search of the Dragon Tools of the Three Heroes.

Features
- Destroy and challenge hordes of enemies in turn-based battles!
- Use Sorcery Stones to learn skills!
- Upgrade weapons by applying special effects!
- Complete the monster guide to gain items!
- Trust affects the ending. Discover by meeting special conditions!

[Supported OS]
- 8.0 and up
[Game Controller]
- Supported
[Languages]
- English, Japanese
[SD Card Storage]
- Enabled (Save backup/transfer are not supported.)
[Non-Supported Devices]
This app has generally been tested to work on any mobile device released in Japan. We cannot guarantee full support on other devices. If you have the Developer Options enabled in your device, please turn off the "Don't keep activities" option in case of any issue. On the title screen, a banner showing latest KEMCO games may be displayed but the game doesn't have any ads from 3rd parties. This banner can also be removed when you want.
